changelog:
Version 1.0.1 – Adds Python entry point and improves usability

- Added scripts/skill_runner.py to provide a unified Python entry point for all skill operations.
- Simplified one-time and recurring automation commands using the new runner script.
- Updated documentation to clarify setup, recurring automation, and Windows-only support.
- Improved description of side effects and environment variable handling.
- Scheduled cron jobs are now registered only at user request, not by default.
